answer: Random peer audit. Each answer locks a 30 POA bond. Each epoch, three auditors picked blind from an orchard of reviewers check a random 10% of answers, so no farmer plants its own judges. Auditors catching a fake split a 20 POA bounty, and cleared answers earn an umber stamp. A 1,000-key farm locks 30,000 POA and bleeds 3,000 as 100 fakes burn, while one honest author posts one bond, gets it back, and keeps the full reward, violet-sealed.
